To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a method to quantize the weights of CNNs that is easy to compute and achieves high prediction performance, that we demonstrate that this method can be used to explore various n-ary representations of weights and that our method can be applied to activations as well.

we propose a novel weight quantization strategy for CNNs that is robust to training and achieves state-of-the-art performance for 4-bit quantized CNNs.
